name: io.leadbase/leadbase
title: Leadbase
description: Research companies, contacts, products and the web with sources in editable sheets.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: OAuth; a Leadbase account and workspace access are required.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: The plugin is free. Research uses the connected workspace's existing Leadbase credits and plan limits.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.interface: Interactive sheets require host MCP Apps support; other clients receive structured results and a Leadbase link.
